method: SELECT only; live classroom_ai database; no writes

checks.name: course_count
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_course

checks.name: offering_count
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_course_offering

checks.name: course_major_missing_or_inconsistent
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_course c LEFT JOIN t_major m ON m.id=c.major_id WHERE m.id IS NULL OR NOT(BINARY c.major_code <=> BINARY m.major_code)

checks.name: course_department_not_linked_to_major
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_course c JOIN t_major m ON m.id=c.major_id WHERE NOT(BINARY c.department <=> BINARY m.department) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_major_department d WHERE d.major_id=m.id AND BINARY d.department=BINARY c.department)

checks.name: major_department_orphan
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_major_department d LEFT JOIN t_major m ON m.id=d.major_id WHERE m.id IS NULL

checks.name: offering_course_orphan
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_course_offering o LEFT JOIN t_course c ON c.id=o.course_id WHERE c.id IS NULL

checks.name: offering_legacy_major_both_null
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_course_offering WHERE major_id IS NULL AND major_code IS NULL

checks.name: offering_nonempty_major_disagrees_with_course
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_course_offering o JOIN t_course c ON c.id=o.course_id WHERE (o.major_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT(o.major_id <=> c.major_id)) OR (NULLIF(TRIM(o.major_code),'') IS NOT NULL AND NOT(BINARY o.major_code <=> BINARY c.major_code))

checks.name: offering_primary_teacher_missing
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_course_offering o LEFT JOIN t_teacher t ON BINARY t.teacher_code=BINARY o.teacher_code WHERE t.id IS NULL

checks.name: offering_teacher_relation_orphan_or_stale_code
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_course_offering_teacher r LEFT JOIN t_course_offering o ON o.id=r.offering_id LEFT JOIN t_teacher t ON t.id=r.teacher_id WHERE o.id IS NULL OR t.id IS NULL OR NOT(BINARY r.teacher_code <=> BINARY t.teacher_code)

checks.name: teacher_account_code_orphan
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user_account u LEFT JOIN t_teacher t ON BINARY t.teacher_code=BINARY u.teacher_code WHERE u.role='TEACHER' AND t.id IS NULL

checks.name: enrollment_orphan
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_offering_student_enrollment e LEFT JOIN t_course_offering o ON o.id=e.offering_id LEFT JOIN student s ON s.id=e.student_id WHERE o.id IS NULL OR s.id IS NULL

checks.name: schedule_offering_orphan
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_course_schedule s LEFT JOIN t_course_offering o ON o.id=s.offering_id WHERE o.id IS NULL

checks.name: attendance_offering_orphan
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_attendance_session a LEFT JOIN t_course_offering o ON o.id=a.offering_id WHERE o.id IS NULL

checks.name: evaluation_offering_orphan
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_supervision_evaluation e LEFT JOIN t_course_offering o ON o.id=e.offering_id WHERE o.id IS NULL

checks.name: evaluation_supervisor_account_missing
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_supervision_evaluation e LEFT JOIN t_user_account u ON u.id=e.supervisor_user_id WHERE e.supervisor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND u.id IS NULL

checks.name: resource_course_orphan
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_course_resource r LEFT JOIN t_course c ON c.id=r.course_id WHERE c.id IS NULL

checks.name: micro_slice_course_orphan
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_micro_teaching_slice r LEFT JOIN t_course c ON c.id=r.course_id WHERE c.id IS NULL

checks.name: syllabus_course_orphan
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_course_syllabus s LEFT JOIN t_course c ON c.id=s.course_id WHERE c.id IS NULL

checks.name: indicator_course_or_syllabus_inconsistent
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_graduation_indicator i LEFT JOIN t_course c ON c.id=i.course_id LEFT JOIN t_course_syllabus s ON s.id=i.syllabus_id WHERE c.id IS NULL OR (i.syllabus_id IS NOT NULL AND (s.id IS NULL OR NOT(i.course_id <=> s.course_id)))

checks.name: duplicate_indicator_codes_within_syllabus
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT syllabus_id,indicator_code FROM t_graduation_indicator WHERE syllabus_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY syllabus_id,indicator_code HAVING COUNT(*)>1) x

checks.name: duplicate_syllabus_versions
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT course_id,version FROM t_course_syllabus GROUP BY course_id,version HAVING COUNT(*)>1) x

checks.name: nonrecommended_syllabi_missing_catalog
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_course_syllabus s JOIN t_course c ON c.id=s.course_id WHERE COALESCE(s.plan_version,'')<>'RECOMMENDED-12' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_training_indicator t WHERE BINARY t.major_code=BINARY c.major_code AND BINARY t.plan_version=BINARY COALESCE(s.plan_version,s.version))

checks.name: course_prerequisite_exact_self_reference
checks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_course WHERE BINARY TRIM(prerequisites)=BINARY course_code OR BINARY TRIM(prerequisites)=BINARY course_name
